text:
Emily: Quick sync — I pushed a fresh draft of the tri-mode landing copy into the doc. Need rapid microcopy passes for Hosted / Dedicated / Private + CTA routing and webinar signpost. https://docs.google.com/example
Jonah: On it. Thinking hero should test two angles: economics (cost/latency) vs trust (security/compliance).
Rachel: Agreed — my instinct is performance-led for Dedicated, security-led for Private, and simplicity for Hosted.
Mike: SEO note: please include 'inference API', 'dedicated GPU', and 'private deployment' in h1/h2 variations. Also keep meta under 155 chars.
Sophie: For inbound routing, we'll need distinct CTAs that map to our CRM tags: hosted_trial, dedicated_request, private_demo. Buttons should be explicit.
Emily: Draft CTA labels I put in the doc — copying here for quick review:
Emily: ```
Hosted — Start free Hosted API
Dedicated — Reserve Dedicated Capacity
Private — Request Private Deployment Demo
```
Jonah: Small tweak: "Reserve Dedicated Capacity" -> "Reserve Dedicated Capacity (SLA options)"? or maybe too long. Thoughts?
Rachel: Too wordy on the button. Keep it short: "Reserve Dedicated Capacity" is fine, but add an explainer line under the button that mentions SLAs.
Mike: Meta description draft for the page: "Redwood Inference — predictable, high-performance LLM inference across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments. Reduce latency and cost while keeping control."
Sophie: Webinar tie-in idea: create a short signpost on the page: "Live webinar: Choosing the right inference deployment — watch replay" with radio buttons to tag interest. That will help SDR routing.
Emily: Love it. Also want a small benchmark callout (latency/cost) and a link to the full benchmark page. Jonah, can you draft a 1-line callout?
Jonah: How about: "Benchmarks: Avg 75ms token latency on common workloads — see our model-by-model results." Short and punchy.
Rachel: Visual layout request: 3-column comparison (Hosted / Dedicated / Private) with one-liners, key metrics, and one CTA each. Use icons, not long paragraphs.
Mike: Headline variants (pick one for A/B testing):
Mike: 1) "Fast, predictable LLM inference for every deployment"
Mike: 2) "Run LLMs where you need them — hosted, dedicated, or private"
Sophie: For A/B, test Variant 1 focusing on speed/price, Variant 2 focusing on deployment flexibility. We'll route the variants to different nurture flows.
Emily: OK — action items: Jonah finalize benchmark blurb + choose hero variant A/B by EOD; Rachel finalize hero copy + 3-col microcopy; Mike finalize meta + SEO headings; Sophie map inbound routing (button->crm tag->hubspot form) and webinar signpost. I'll update the doc after merges.
Marvin (deploy-bot): staging deploy completed: https://staging.redwood.ai (build 2026-04-01-17:02) :white_check_mark:
Emily: Thanks! Please post final snippets here when ready. :pray:
